scope: Handwritten service obligations supplement the complete pinned metamodel node inventory; planned cases are not executable evidence

obligations.title: conversion delegates
obligations.requirement: Typed datatype conversion delegates require registered implementations and preserve lexical/value failures

cases.positive: Convert and round-trip a custom decimal datatype
cases.negative: Reject a missing converter and overflow without a default substitute
cases.boundary: Distinguish null, empty lexical value and unset

obligations.title: setting delegates
obligations.requirement: Derived and dynamic feature reads/writes invoke typed setting delegates

cases.positive: Read a derived collection through reflection and typed API
cases.negative: Reject absent provider and invalid write effect
cases.boundary: Inherited provider override and duplicate binding

obligations.title: invocation delegates
obligations.requirement: Operations dispatch by receiver and signature with checked exceptions

cases.positive: Execute an overloaded operation with typed parameters
cases.negative: Reject wrong receiver/arity and missing implementation
cases.boundary: Overload identity and inherited override

obligations.title: validation delegates
obligations.requirement: Validation applicability and constraint providers preserve diagnostic outcomes

cases.positive: Execute named constraint with structured diagnostic
cases.negative: Missing provider remains unsupported instead of valid
cases.boundary: Inherited applicability and multiple diagnostics

obligations.title: uri fragments
obligations.requirement: Stable resource identity and fragment resolution use explicit adapters

cases.positive: Resolve contained and ID-based objects across resources
cases.negative: Reject missing or ambiguous fragment
cases.boundary: Escaped fragments and move/reload identity

obligations.title: resource state
obligations.requirement: Load/unload, diagnostics and resource state remain distinct from model validity

cases.positive: Load and unload supplied resource bytes
cases.negative: Failed load preserves prior published revision
cases.boundary: Unload referenced resource and retry without stale proxies

obligations.title: resource set
obligations.requirement: Explicit resource registries select revision-specific dependencies

cases.positive: Resolve a cross-resource proxy with supplied URI map
cases.negative: Missing resource reports unresolved without implicit host I/O
cases.boundary: Multiple revisions and cyclic resource references

obligations.title: extended metadata
obligations.requirement: Namespace, element/attribute and content-kind annotations affect the shared codec

cases.positive: Round-trip annotated element and attribute names
cases.negative: Reject conflicting or unsupported content metadata
cases.boundary: Mixed content and wildcard namespace handling

obligations.title: feature maps
obligations.requirement: Feature maps preserve grouped/mixed ordered entries through serialization

cases.positive: Round-trip interleaved feature-map entries
cases.negative: Reject incompatible grouped value type
cases.boundary: Empty entries, repeated values and significant text

obligations.title: value converters
obligations.requirement: Terminal/datatype values use declared bidirectional converters

cases.positive: Convert escaped identifier and numeric values
cases.negative: Reject invalid escape and numeric range
cases.boundary: Exact lexical source and round-trip spelling

obligations.title: scoping
obligations.requirement: Language scope supplies typed visible candidates for references

cases.positive: Resolve local, imported and inherited name
cases.negative: Report ambiguity or missing candidate at link stage
cases.boundary: Shadowing and absent-lookup invalidation

obligations.title: linking
obligations.requirement: Cross-reference syntax and scope jointly produce model links

cases.positive: Resolve qualified datatype reference spelling
cases.negative: Wrong target type never becomes a valid link
cases.boundary: Multiple resources and repeated link requests

obligations.title: naming
obligations.requirement: Qualified names are supplied by explicit language policy

cases.positive: Compute nested names from model structure
cases.negative: Reject ambiguous names without ordinal guessing
cases.boundary: Unnamed elements and renamed ancestors

obligations.title: resource index
obligations.requirement: Exported objects and reference descriptions feed a shared resource index

cases.positive: Find references across open resource descriptions
cases.negative: Reject stale index revision
cases.boundary: Rename, delete and absent reference target updates

obligations.title: serializer
obligations.requirement: Model-to-text serialization obeys grammar and reports unrepresentable objects

cases.positive: Parse serialize parse with equal model graph
cases.negative: Reject graph lacking any legal grammar representation
cases.boundary: Actions, optional values and preserved comments

obligations.title: resource validation
obligations.requirement: Validation modes, cancellation and diagnostic severity are explicit

cases.positive: Run all applicable constraints for current revision
cases.negative: Missing algorithm remains unassessed
cases.boundary: Cancel during validation without publishing valid status

obligations.title: concrete syntax validation
obligations.requirement: Validate graph representability before serialization

cases.positive: Accept representable direct-API model
cases.negative: Reject mismatched assignment cardinality
cases.boundary: Unassigned calls and action-created objects

obligations.title: parse recovery
obligations.requirement: Parser recovery retains errors and source spans rather than validating partial input

cases.positive: Recover enough nodes for incomplete editor text
cases.negative: Malformed text cannot publish a valid complete model
cases.boundary: Error at EOF and nested action rollback

obligations.title: node model
obligations.requirement: Node model retains text, hidden trivia and semantic associations

cases.positive: Map semantic feature to exact text span
cases.negative: Detect stale/out-of-range spans
cases.boundary: Unicode offsets and empty/trivia-only nodes

obligations.title: formatting
obligations.requirement: Language formatter edits text without changing model semantics

cases.positive: Format and reparse equivalent model
cases.negative: Invalid formatting provider produces explicit error
cases.boundary: Comments, hidden tokens and idempotent formatting
